definitions.gloss: supplier; vendor; source of goods; procurement source
definitions.explanation: A company, person, or place from which goods are purchased for resale or use in business. A fundamental term in commerce and business.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{仕入先|しいれさき}を{探|さが}す。
examples.english: To look for a new supplier.

examples.japanese: {仕入先|しいれさき}との{価格|かかく}{交渉|こうしょう}が{難航|なんこう}している。
examples.english: Price negotiations with the supplier are proving difficult.

examples.japanese: {仕入先|しいれさき}を{複数|ふくすう}{確保|かくほ}しておくことで、{供給|きょうきゅう}リスクを{分散|ぶんさん}できる。
examples.english: By securing multiple suppliers, you can spread the supply risk.

notes:
Composed of {仕入|しい}れ (purchasing, stocking) + {先|さき} (destination, party). The suffix {先|さき} is productive in business Japanese, creating words for counterparties: {取引先|とりひきさき} (business partner), {納入先|のうにゅうさき} (delivery destination), {販売先|はんばいさき} (customer/sales destination).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕入先|しいれさき}を{探|さが}す: to look for a supplier
- {仕入先|しいれさき}を{変|か}える: to change suppliers
- {仕入先|しいれさき}との{関係|かんけい}: relationship with suppliers
- {仕入先|しいれさき}を{開拓|かいたく}する: to develop new suppliers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- サプライヤー: supplier (loanword; common in manufacturing and international business)
- {取引先|とりひきさき}: business partner (broader; includes both suppliers and customers)
- {卸売業者|おろしうりぎょうしゃ}: wholesaler (a specific type of supplier)
